confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Labuan Bajo as a small Flores tourism hub; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak dry-season and Komodo tourism high season and supply is volatile, so each is a bounded estimate. Hotel and hostel prices are assumed to include Indonesian taxes and service charges. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship (roughly 2x and 3x beer), since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Indonesian island tourism towns with similar visitor profiles, such as Kuta and Senggigi on Lombok and the Gili Islands, adjusted for Labuan Bajo's July high-season premium and its limited supply of mid-range rooms. No web search was used for city-price anchors.
